facts.text: The hotel is right next to the Kurpark, in the middle of Engelberg's village centre with its small shops, cafes and monastery.
facts.excerpt: Kempinski Palace Engelberg is situated right next to the Kurpark, in the middle of the charming village centre with its small shops, cosy cafés and world-famous monastery.

facts.text: The aerial cableways into the mountains are a few minutes' walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The aerial cableways to Central Switzerland’s largest outdoor paradise are just a few minutes away on foot.

facts.text: The Titlis cable car station is 600 metres from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Titlis cable car station: 600 m

facts.text: Engelberg Abbey is 500 metres from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Engelberg Abbey: 500 m

facts.text: Engelberg is reached by the Zentralbahn railway from Zurich or Lucerne, and the train station is 100 metres from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Travel from Zurich or Lucerne to Engelberg on the "Zentralbahn" railway. The journey from Zurich takes around 1 hour and 40 minutes and the train station is just 100 metres from the hotel.

facts.text: There is a heliport 300 metres from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: There is a heliport only 300 metres from Kempinski Palace Engelberg.

facts.text: For more than a decade every guest has been welcomed by the hotel's Lady in Red, a host dressed in red who offers help and local knowledge.
facts.excerpt: For more than a decade every guest has been welcomed by our Lady in Red, providing thoughtful, individual and intuitive help and expertise. Dressed in striking red, this impeccable host has unrivalled knowledge about the hotel and the local area.

facts.text: The Ladies in Red make sure birthdays, anniversaries and other occasions are celebrated in style.
facts.excerpt: Whether it's birthdays, anniversaries, or other occasions - they ensure that each event is celebrated in style.

facts.text: The Kids Club is certified by the Luxury Childcare Association.
facts.excerpt: Our Kids Club, proudly certified by the Luxury Childcare Association, offers a safe and imaginative environment designed to inspire joy, creativity, and friendship.

facts.text: The Kids Club has kitchen, shop, reading and arts-and-crafts corners, and children play there without electronic devices.
facts.excerpt: Here, children can explore, learn, and play — without electronic devices.

facts.text: Intersport Achermann has an in-house shop renting ski, snowboard, cross-country, hiking, golf and bike equipment.
facts.excerpt: You don’t even have to leave the hotel to find the right equipment: Intersport Achermann is located in-house with a wide range of products.

facts.text: The Activity Concierge puts together programmes, arranges cable car tickets and a hiking guide, and can show guests the region himself on an e-bike.
facts.excerpt: Or he can show you the region himself on an e-bike: you are sure to feel particularly close to heaven in Engelberg.

facts.text: The spa has a pool area, a sauna area and a fitness centre.
facts.excerpt: Pool Area: 08:00 to 22:00

facts.text: Some room categories, including the Premier Room, Junior Suite, Titlis Suite, Belle Epoque Suite and Park Suite, accommodate up to four guests, and connecting rooms are possible.
facts.excerpt: We can accommodate up to 4 guests in some of our room categories ( Premier Room, Junior Suite, Titlis Suite, Belle Époque Suite, Park Suite), however there is also a possibility to have connecting rooms.

facts.text: All rooms are non-smoking, but smoking is permitted on the balcony.
facts.excerpt: All our rooms are non-smoking rooms, however it is permitted to smoke on your balcony.

facts.text: Dining venues include Cattani, the Palace Bar and in-room dining, with vegetarian and vegan dishes across all of them.
facts.excerpt: We have thoughtfully crafted a variety of exquisite vegetarian and vegan dishes across all of our dining experiences in Cattani, Palace Bar and in-room dining.

facts.text: Breakfast is a buffet of local and regional products and international classics, with some a la carte options at no surcharge.
facts.excerpt: It is a buffet breakfast with some a la carte options (no surcharge).

facts.text: The hotel has the Habanos Cigar Lounge.
facts.excerpt: For smokers, Kempinski Palace Engelberg offers the cosy _Habanos Cigar Lounge_.

facts.text: Dogs up to 30 kg are welcome in some areas of the hotel and receive a dog bed, bowls with treats and a toy, for a nightly fee.
facts.excerpt: Up to a maximum of 30kg are welcome in some areas of our hotel. The accommodation package includes a dog bed, bowls with treats and a dog toy.

facts.text: Ski tickets and day or week passes can be bought at the hotel's reception desk.
facts.excerpt: We offer the possibility of purchasing ski tickets and day or week passes conveniently at our reception desk.

facts.text: Hotel guests can buy TITLIS Tower tickets at reception at a preferential rate, including the return cable car to Titlis and the Horizon Deck; the offer is valid until June 2027.
facts.excerpt: Hotel guests may purchase tickets for the TITLIS Tower at Reception at the preferential rate of CHF 110 (regular price: CHF 121).

facts.text: The hotel's Golf Fun Package arranges the green fee and tee time at the 18-hole Engelberg-Titlis golf course.
facts.excerpt: Thanks to our **Golf Fun Package**, you can concentrate fully on the game while we take care of the green fee and tee time.

facts.text: Snow and ice are common on the roads in the canton of Obwalden, especially in winter, and the hotel strongly recommends winter equipment for cars.
facts.excerpt: Snow and ice are common on the roads in the canton of Obwalden, especially during the winter months. Therefore, we strongly recommend appropriate winter equipment.

facts.text: Dogs are welcome only in some areas of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Yes, dogs are very welcome in some areas of our hotel.

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as raw luxury high up in the Swiss Alps.
facts.excerpt: Raw Luxury, high up in the Swiss Alps

facts.text: The Titlis ski season starts as early as October and runs until May.
facts.excerpt: the ski season on the Titlis starts as early as October and does not end until May.
